INNER HEAD. [3] [Asaf.]
Nervous headache of hysterical or scrofulous people.
   

SIGHT AND EYES. [5] [Asaf.]
Nocturnal, throbbing pains in and around eye and head. θ Syphilitic iritis, abuse of mercury.
Extensive superficial ulceration of cornea, with burning, sticking or pressing pains, from within outward ; rest and pressure relieve ; also > in open air ; numbness around eye.
   

SMELL AND NOSE. [7] [Asaf.]
Offensive discharge from nose ; stench from nose. θ After mercury or in scrofula.
Discharge of very offensive matter from nose ; with caries of bones. θ Ozæna.
   

LOWER FACE. [9] [Asaf.]
Swelling of lower lip.
   

PALATE AND THROAT. [13] [Asaf.]
Sensation of a ball rising in throat, causes difficulty in breathing. θ Hysteria.
   

HICCOUGH, BELCHING, NAUSEA AND VOMITING. [16] [Asaf.]
Eructations : smelling like garlic ; tasting rancid, sharp, or putrid ; smelling like feces ; tasting like carrion.
Flatus passing upward, none down.
   

HYPOCHONDRIA. [18] [Asaf.]
Heat in spleen and abdomen.
   

STOOLS AND RECTUM. [20] [Asaf.]
Watery, liquid stools of most disgusting smell ; pains in abdomen and discharge of fetid flatus.
Watery stools of disgusting odor ; discharge profuse and greenish.
   

URINARY ORGANS. [21] [Asaf.]
Urine warm and of a pungent, ammoniacal smell.
   

RESPIRATION. [26] [Asaf.]
Asthmatic feeling in trachea, dry cough ; spasmodic dyspnœa as if lungs could not be sufficiently expanded.
   

HEART, PULSE AND CIRCULATION. [29] [Asaf.]
Nervous palpitation, with small pulse ; from overexertion or suppression of discharges (in women).
   

NERVES. [36] [Asaf.]
Hysteria, with much trouble about throat or œsophagus ; well-marked globus hystericus ; spasms of lungs, etc.
Nervous affections after suppressed discharges.
   

STAGE OF LIFE, CONSTITUTION. [47] [Asaf.]
Nervous people.
